title: [Bug] FP8 MHA hybrid model crashes: HybridLinearAttnBackend has no forward_metadata
body:
## Summary
With `--kv-cache-dtype fp8_e4m3` on a hybrid GLM-5 model, the first DSA prefill with extend/cached-prefix data crashes because `_get_mla_kv_buffer_from_fp8_for_dsa` tries to read `backend.forward_metadata.page_table_1_flattened` from `HybridLinearAttnBackend`, which does not expose `forward_metadata`.

## Environment
- Branch/commit: 654df43cbee108a81fa1736c34ba8c701f199285 (fork `long10024070/sglang`)
- Hardware: AMD MI350X / gfx950
- Model: amd/GLM-5.3-Flash-Quark-MXFP4
- Server args: `--dp-size 4 --tp-size 1 --attention-backend dsa --dsa-prefill-backend tilelang --dsa-decode-backend tilelang --linear-attn-backend triton --moe-runner-backend aiter --kv-cache-dtype fp8_e4m3`

## Stack trace
- `hybrid_linear_attn_backend.py`: `get_attn_backend()` returns `HybridLinearAttnBackend` wrapper for a hybrid model.
- `forward_mha.py:500` in `_get_mla_kv_buffer_from_fp8_for_dsa`: `backend.forward_metadata.page_table_1_flattened`
- Error: `AttributeError: 'HybridLinearAttnBackend' object has no attribute 'forward_metadata'`

## Proposed fix
Unwrap the hybrid wrapper exactly like the existing `TboAttnBackend` unwrap:

```python
if isinstance(backend, HybridLinearAttnBackend):
    backend = backend.full_attn_backend
kv_indices = backend.forward_metadata.page_table_1_flattened
```

The full-attn child owns the DSA `forward_metadata` and `page_table_1_flattened`.

## Validation
After the fix, the same server successfully completed deterministic generation, structured reasoning, tool-call round trip, and native protocol canary on gfx950.
